zh-cn.home.title: Welcome to Auto Clicker - AutoFill
zh-cn.home.subtitle: Automate clicks and form fills on any website by defining targets and actions.
zh-cn.home.quickStart.title: Quick Start Guide
zh-cn.home.quickStart.step1.title: 1. Install the Extension
zh-cn.home.quickStart.step1.desc: Download and install the extension from the Chrome Web Store or Edge Add-ons.
zh-cn.home.quickStart.step2.title: 2. Configure a Target Page
zh-cn.home.quickStart.step2.desc: Open a web page, right-click any element and choose Auto Clicker - AutoFill → Configure for this Field.
zh-cn.home.quickStart.step3.title: 3. Save & Run
zh-cn.home.quickStart.step3.desc: Save your configuration and reload the target page. The automation runs automatically.
zh-cn.home.tips.title: Helpful Tips
zh-cn.home.tips.tip1.title: Try on the Test Page
zh-cn.home.tips.tip1.desc: Open test.getautoclicker.com, add two actions — one to fill a username field and one to click a button — then save and run.
zh-cn.home.tips.tip2.title: Target Items Precisely
zh-cn.home.tips.tip2.desc: Use element paths to target specific items on a page, like //input[@name="username"], for more reliable automation.
zh-cn.home.tips.tip3.title: Handle Slow Page Loads
zh-cn.home.tips.tip3.desc: Set a Wait Before Start on your automation if the page loads slowly before your steps run.
zh-cn.home.tips.tip4.title: Global Settings & Hotkeys
zh-cn.home.tips.tip4.desc: Configure start mode, define a keyboard shortcut, and adjust the status bar position in Global Settings.
zh-cn.home.tips.tip5.title: Right-click to Auto-Capture
zh-cn.home.tips.tip5.desc: Right-click any input or button on a page and select Configure for this Field to auto-fill the URL and Element Finder.

sv.home.quickStart.step2.title: 2. Configure a Target Page

ru.home.quickStart.step2.title: 2. Configure a Target Page

fil.upgradePlan.alternativePayment.descripti: Dodo Payments isn't available in every country, and in some regions it only supports credit cards. If you can't use Dodo Payments in your country (or you need a non-card option), you can pay through one of these instead:
fil.upgradePlan.alternativePayment.step1: Pay for the number of months you want to subscribe, using the plan's monthly price. For example, six months cost (monthly price) × 6.
fil.upgradePlan.alternativePayment.step2: your account email, the plan and number of months, and proof of payment — your GitHub Sponsors receipt, or your PayPal email address / transaction ID if you paid via PayPal.
fil.upgradePlan.alternativePayment.step3: We'll manually enable your plan from our backend for the number of months you paid for, and it will auto-expire after that period.
fil.upgradePlan.alternativePayment.note: since these payments aren't processed through our automated checkout, we enable plans manually and it can take up to 72 hours. To avoid a gap in service, we recommend prepaying at least 3–6 months at a time.
